title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Yaeno Muteki…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her eyes seem drawn to a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies called cuties.
choice_data_list: Do you want one of those plushies?
Do you want one of those plushies?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's not a question of desire. I simply cannot have one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I were to get one… If I were to cradle it in my arms…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And see those pleading eyes… I would need to protect it!
choice_data_list: Let's get you some plushies to protect, then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Get plushies for the purpose of protecting them? That is one way to look at it…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Very well. I pray for your success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
